profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. Its website describes it as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies.

Per its site, the Appian Platform lets customers build AI-powered processes, and the company markets capabilities across process automation, artificial intelligence, and legacy application modernization. The site lists uses including AP, AR, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier management, low-code app building with embedded AI agents, audit workflows, case resolution, purchase-to-pay, onboarding, order fulfillment, and contract review. Appian also cites a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors and an AI value study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The site states that onboarding automation can cut time by up to 50%. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or tracked products are recorded for the company.
